tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description:
Read the transcript of a video, one page at a time. Use it when you need the exact words (quote, answer from a passage, translate, copy, review). On long videos, call get_video_context and search_video first, then pass from and to here so you read only the relevant part.
Returns "[mm:ss] text" lines

tools.name: get_video_context
tools.description: Start here for any video. findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_transcript" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.detail: Tool "get_transcript" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

Use it when you need the exact words (quote, answer from a passage, translate, copy, review). On long videos, call get_video_context and search_video first, then pass from and to here so you read only the relevant part.
